name: Inferno Kick-Off: Voidspire, DJs, Give aways ++
description:
On October 28th we have the pleasure of inviting you to Inferno kick-off at Vaterland, Oslo.
In the evening Voidspire will be performing live.

Voidspire is a death metal band from Oslo featuring members from Horrifier, Ruun, Blodkarsk, and Celestial Scourge. The band draws inspiration from the darker reaches of death metal while carving out a distinctly melancholic sound of their own.
Also, In the afternoon, there will be a seminar at Byens Tak about the topic of the metal city Oslo, how it came to be and how different it can be elsewhere like in Russia who have officially banned Satanism and attacked extreme metal with that.

Free entrance!
